sn1.25:1.1:
“An arahant monk,
one who is done,
sn1.25:1.3:
Would he say, ‘I speak’?
Would he say,
sn1.25:2.1:
“An arahant monk,
one who is done,
sn1.25:2.5:
Skillful,
knowing harmonious gnosis
with regard to the world,
sn1.25:2.6:
he uses expressions
just as expressions.”
sn1.25:3.1:
“An arahant monk,
one who is done,
sn1.25:3.4:
that he’d say, ‘ I speak’?—
that he’d say,
sn1.25:4.2:
whose knot of conceit is dispersed,
no knots exist
at all.
sn1.25:5.2:
Skillful,
knowing harmonious gnosis
with regard to the world,
sn1.25:5.3:
he uses expressions
just as expressions.”
